    index, separator, path = value.partition('=')

        raise ValueError('native selection requires ASCII decimal INDEX=PATH')
    return dict(import_index=int(index), format=kind, artifact=parse_json(
        bibliographic_intake.read_bounded(Path(path), min(MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES, FORMATS[kind].MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES))))

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    make = commands.add_parser('create')
    make.add_argument('protocol', type=Path)
    make.add_argument('output', type=Path)
    for kind in FORMATS:

    make.add_argument('--text', action='store_true')
    check = commands.add_parser('verify')
    check.add_argument('bundle', type=Path)
    check.add_argument('--text', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        output = None
        if args.command == 'create':
            choices = [(kind, value) for kind in FORMATS for value in getattr(args, kind)]
            if not 1 <= len(choices) <= MAX_BINDINGS:
                raise ValueError('supply between 1 and 100 explicit native wrapper bindings')

            result = _built_summary(output)
        else:
            result = verify_bundle(bibliographic_intake.read_bounded(args.bundle, MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES))
        stdout = render_text(result).encode('utf-8') if args.text else _json_bytes(result)
        _size(len(stdout))
        if output is not None:
            _write_new(args.output, output)
    except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError, TypeError, UnicodeError, RecursionError,
            zipfile.BadZipFile, zipfile.LargeZipFile, NotImplementedError, RuntimeError, EOFError) as error:
        parser.exit(1, 'Native collection bundle error: ' + quoted_display(str(error)) + '\n')
    print(stdout.decode('utf-8'), end='')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

def input_locations(protocol, queue, sections, items):
    """Resolve typed IDs and authoritative search indices, not arbitrary ID strings."""
    domain={**QUEUE_DOMAINS, **OPTIONAL_QUEUE_DOMAINS}[queue]
    if domain == 'search_index':
        return list(dict.fromkeys('/searches/' + str(item['search_index']) for item in items or []))
    if domain == 'inventory_candidate_review':
        pairs = {(item['report_id'], item['study_id']) for item in items or []}
        report_ids = {rid for rid, _ in pairs}
        paths = [f'/reports/{index}' for index, row in enumerate(protocol.get('reports', []))
                 if row['report_id'] in report_ids]
        paths += [f'/report_sources/{index}' for index, row in enumerate(protocol.get('report_sources', []))
                  if row['report_id'] in report_ids]
        for section in ('report_study_inventory', 'report_study_inventory_reviews'):
            paths += [f'/{section}/{index}' for index, row in enumerate(protocol.get(section, []))
                      if (row['report_id'], row['study_id']) in pairs]
        return paths
    if domain == 'report_study_review':
        pairs = {(item['report_id'], item['study_id']) for item in items or []}
        report_ids = {rid for rid, _ in pairs}
        report_for_record = {record: row['report_id'] for row in protocol.get('reports', [])
                             for record in row['record_ids']}
        paths = [f'/reports/{index}' for index, row in enumerate(protocol.get('reports', []))
                 if any((row['report_id'], sid) in pairs for sid in report_study_ids(row))]
        paths += [f'/report_sources/{index}' for index, row in enumerate(protocol.get('report_sources', []))
                  if row['report_id'] in report_ids]
        paths += [f'/report_study_reviews/{index}' for index, row in enumerate(protocol.get('report_study_reviews', []))
                  if (row['report_id'], row['study_id']) in pairs]
        paths += [f'/evidence/{index}' for index, row in enumerate(protocol['evidence'])
                  if (report_for_record.get(row['record_id']), row['study_id']) in pairs]
        return paths
    if domain == 'report_study':
        pairs = {(item['report_id'], item['study_id']) for item in items or []}
        return [f'/reports/{index}' for index, row in enumerate(protocol.get('reports', []))
                if any((row['report_id'], study_id) in pairs for study_id in report_study_ids(row))]
    ids={item if isinstance(item,str) else item[domain + '_id'] for item in items or []}
    linked_statements, linked_work = set(), set()
    if domain == 'challenge':
        for row in protocol.get('challenges', []) if isinstance(protocol.get('challenges'), list) else []:
            if isinstance(row, dict) and row.get('challenge_id') in ids:
                linked_statements.update(sid for sid in (row.get('statement_ids') or []) if isinstance(sid, str))
                reopening = row.get('reopening')
                if isinstance(reopening, dict) and isinstance(reopening.get('work_package_id'), str):
                    linked_work.add(reopening['work_package_id'])
    matches=[]
    for section in sections:
        entries=protocol.get(section, [])
        if not isinstance(entries,list): continue
        for index,row in enumerate(entries):
            if not isinstance(row,dict): continue
            values=[]
            wanted=ids
            if domain=='record':
                if section in ('searches','reports'): values=row.get('record_ids',[])
                elif section in ('screening','evidence','screening_reviews'): values=[row.get('record_id')]
            elif domain=='evidence':
                if section in ('evidence','evidence_bases'): values=[row.get('evidence_id',row.get('record_id'))]
                elif section in ('appraisals','experimental_units','synthesis_statements'): values=row.get('evidence_ids',[])
            elif domain=='work_package':
                if section=='gaps': values=[row.get('work_package_id',f'WP-{index+1:03}')]
                elif section=='planning_decisions': values=[row.get('work_package_id')]
            elif domain=='statement' and section=='evidence_bases':
                wanted={eid for statement in protocol.get('synthesis_statements',[]) if statement['statement_id'] in ids for eid in statement['evidence_ids']}
                values=[row.get('evidence_id')]
            elif domain=='statement' and section=='challenges': values=row.get('statement_ids',[])
            elif domain=='challenge':
                if section=='challenges': values=[row.get('challenge_id')]
                elif section=='synthesis_statements': values=[row.get('statement_id')]; wanted=linked_statements
                elif section=='gaps': values=[row.get('work_package_id',f'WP-{index+1:03}')]; wanted=linked_work
            else:
                fields={'search':('search_plan','searches'), 'report':('reports','report_sources','report_reviews'),
                        'experiment':('experimental_units',), 'statement':('synthesis_statements',),
                        'context':('contexts',)}
                if section in fields[domain]: values=[row.get(domain + '_id')]
            if isinstance(values,list) and any(isinstance(value,str) and value in wanted for value in values):
                matches.append('/' + section + '/' + str(index))
    return matches

MAX_CLI_INPUT_BYTES = 50_000_000
MAX_CLI_NESTING = 128


def _read_cli_input(path, label, parser):
    try:
        with path.open('rb') as stream:
            raw = stream.read(MAX_CLI_INPUT_BYTES + 1)
    except OSError:
        parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-unreadable: ' + label + ': "Unable to read supplied input."\n')
    if len(raw) > MAX_CLI_INPUT_BYTES:
        parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-too-large: ' + label + ': "Input exceeds 50000000 bytes."\n')
    try:
        value = parse_json(raw.decode('utf-8'))
    except JsonNestingError as error:
        if error.reason == 'decoder_capacity':
            parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-too-complex: ' + label + ': "JSON nesting exceeds parser capacity."\n')
        parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-too-complex: ' + label + ': "JSON nesting exceeds 128 levels."\n')
    except RecursionError:
        parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-too-complex: ' + label + ': "JSON nesting exceeds parser capacity."\n')
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-not-json: ' + label + ': "Expected strict UTF-8 JSON."\n')
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-invalid: ' + label + ': "Expected a JSON object."\n')
    pending = [(value, 0)]
    while pending:
        item, depth = pending.pop()
        if depth > MAX_CLI_NESTING:
            parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-too-complex: ' + label + ': "JSON nesting exceeds 128 levels."\n')
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            pending.extend((child, depth + 1) for child in item.values())
        elif isinstance(item, list):
            pending.extend((child, depth + 1) for child in item)
    return value


def main():
    configure_utf8_stdio()
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('protocol',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--work-package')
    parser.add_argument('--text',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--research-map',type=Path,help='optional standalone authored sidecar; not a gate')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    try:

        result=handoff(_read_cli_input(args.protocol, 'protocol', parser),args.work_package,
                       research_map=read_document(args.research_map) if args.research_map else _NO_RESEARCH_MAP)
        rendered=render_text(result) if args.text else json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n'
        if args.research_map and len(rendered.encode('utf-8'))>50_000_000:raise ValueError('optional output limit')
    except (ValueError,OSError,KeyError,TypeError,RecursionError):
        if args.research_map:parser.exit(1,'review handoff error: input-invalid: protocol or research map: \"Supplied view inputs could not be checked.\"\n')
        parser.exit(1,'review handoff error: input-invalid: protocol or work selection: "Supplied input failed validation; check required fields, relationships and selected work ID."\n')

                  if (report_for_record.get(row['record_id']), row['study_id']) in pairs]
        return paths
    if domain == 'report_study':
        pairs = {(item['report_id'], item['study_id']) for item in items or []}
        return [f'/reports/{index}' for index, row in enumerate(protocol.get('reports', []))
                if any((row['report_id'], study_id) in pairs for study_id in report_study_ids(row))]
    ids={item if isinstance(item,str) else item[domain + '_id'] for item in items or []}
    linked_statements, linked_work = set(), set()
    if domain == 'challenge':
        for row in protocol.get('challenges', []) if isinstance(protocol.get('challenges'), list) else []:
            if isinstance(row, dict) and row.get('challenge_id') in ids:
                linked_statements.update(sid for sid in (row.get('statement_ids') or []) if isinstance(sid, str))
                reopening = row.get('reopening')
                if isinstance(reopening, dict) and isinstance(reopening.get('work_package_id'), str):
                    linked_work.add(reopening['work_package_id'])
    matches=[]
    for section in sections:
        entries=protocol.get(section, [])
        if not isinstance(entries,list): continue
        for index,row in enumerate(entries):
            if not isinstance(row,dict): continue
            values=[]
            wanted=ids
            if domain=='record':
                if section in ('searches','reports'): values=row.get('record_ids',[])
                elif section in ('screening','evidence','screening_reviews'): values=[row.get('record_id')]
            elif domain=='evidence':
                if section in ('evidence','evidence_bases'): values=[row.get('evidence_id',row.get('record_id'))]
                elif section in ('appraisals','experimental_units','synthesis_statements'): values=row.get('evidence_ids',[])
            elif domain=='work_package':
                if section=='gaps': values=[row.get('work_package_id',f'WP-{index+1:03}')]
                elif section=='planning_decisions': values=[row.get('work_package_id')]
            elif domain=='statement' and section=='evidence_bases':
                wanted={eid for statement in protocol.get('synthesis_statements',[]) if statement['statement_id'] in ids for eid in statement['evidence_ids']}
                values=[row.get('evidence_id')]
            elif domain=='statement' and section=='challenges': values=row.get('statement_ids',[])
            elif domain=='challenge':
                if section=='challenges': values=[row.get('challenge_id')]
                elif section=='synthesis_statements': values=[row.get('statement_id')]; wanted=linked_statements
                elif section=='gaps': values=[row.get('work_package_id',f'WP-{index+1:03}')]; wanted=linked_work
            else:
                fields={'search':('search_plan','searches'), 'report':('reports','report_sources','report_reviews'),
                        'experiment':('experimental_units',), 'statement':('synthesis_statements',),
                        'context':('contexts',)}
                if section in fields[domain]: values=[row.get(domain + '_id')]
            if isinstance(values,list) and any(isinstance(value,str) and value in wanted for value in values):
                matches.append('/' + section + '/' + str(index))
    return matches

# CLI-only input limits; in-memory engine functions and result schemas are unchanged.
MAX_CLI_INPUT_BYTES = 50_000_000
MAX_CLI_NESTING = 128


def _read_cli_input(path, label, parser):
    try:
        with path.open('rb') as stream:
            raw = stream.read(MAX_CLI_INPUT_BYTES + 1)
    except OSError:
        parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-unreadable: ' + label + ': "Unable to read supplied input."\n')
    if len(raw) > MAX_CLI_INPUT_BYTES:
        parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-too-large: ' + label + ': "Input exceeds 50000000 bytes."\n')
    try:
        value = parse_json(raw.decode('utf-8'))
    except JsonNestingError as error:
        if error.reason == 'decoder_capacity':
            parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-too-complex: ' + label + ': "JSON nesting exceeds parser capacity."\n')
        parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-too-complex: ' + label + ': "JSON nesting exceeds 128 levels."\n')
    except RecursionError:
        parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-too-complex: ' + label + ': "JSON nesting exceeds parser capacity."\n')
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-not-json: ' + label + ': "Expected strict UTF-8 JSON."\n')
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-invalid: ' + label + ': "Expected a JSON object."\n')
    pending = [(value, 0)]
    while pending:
        item, depth = pending.pop()
        if depth > MAX_CLI_NESTING:
            parser.exit(1, 'review handoff error: input-too-complex: ' + label + ': "JSON nesting exceeds 128 levels."\n')
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            pending.extend((child, depth + 1) for child in item.values())
        elif isinstance(item, list):
            pending.extend((child, depth + 1) for child in item)
    return value

    configure_utf8_stdio()
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('protocol',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--work-package')
    parser.add_argument('--text',action='store_true')

    args=parser.parse_args()
    try:
        from research_map_views import read_document
        result=handoff(_read_cli_input(args.protocol, 'protocol', parser),args.work_package,
                       research_map=read_document(args.research_map) if args.research_map else _NO_RESEARCH_MAP)
        rendered=render_text(result) if args.text else json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n'
        if args.research_map and len(rendered.encode('utf-8'))>50_000_000:raise ValueError('optional output limit')
    except (ValueError,OSError,KeyError,TypeError,RecursionError):
        if args.research_map:parser.exit(1,'review handoff error: input-invalid: protocol or research map: \"Supplied view inputs could not be checked.\"\n')
        parser.exit(1,'review handoff error: input-invalid: protocol or work selection: "Supplied input failed validation; check required fields, relationships and selected work ID."\n')
    print(rendered,end='')
